the owner cupboard

Checking the cupboard…

everybody gets something

Gifts go into wallets without changing lifetime earnings. Reclaim removes up to the gifted amount from current wallets; it never undoes purchases or makes wallets negative.

deliveries & live boosts

Online only takes a snapshot when you send. Closed or inactive pages drop off within 10 seconds. Boost recipients keep the boost until it ends. Everyone means all current accounts for points. Global multipliers also cover accounts joining during the event. Highest active multiplier wins; boosts do not stack.

a little favour

take something back

Wallets and levels stop at zero. Removing an equipped character switches them to Factory settings. Lifetime earnings and earned achievements stay.

title department

Titles appear next to their name on leaderboards. Leave empty to clear a title. Titles do not give panel access.

quiet department

Zero minutes means until unmuted. Silences click sounds, cartoon effects and background music while using this account. Only jacob can change admin accounts’ sound mutes.

announcement department

Appears immediately on connected pages and disappears after this many seconds. Everyone includes guests. Players can dismiss it.

panel access · jacob only

Admins can give and remove items, run events and assign titles. Only jacob can change panel access or reset/restore the whole game. Your owner account cannot be demoted.
